instruction: Create an ice freeze effect that encases a character in an ice block and shatters it.
output:
local TweenService = game:GetService('TweenService')
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')

local function freeze(character, duration)
    local root = character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    if not root or not humanoid then return end

    local oldSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0

    local ice = Instance.new('Part')
    ice.Size = Vector3.new(5, 7, 5)
    ice.Material = Enum.Material.Ice
    ice.Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 220, 255)
    ice.Transparency = 0.35
    ice.Anchored = true
    ice.CanCollide = false
    ice.CFrame = root.CFrame
    ice.Parent = workspace

    task.delay(duration, function()
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = oldSpeed
        local shatter = TweenService:Create(ice, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Transparency = 1, Size = ice.Size * 1.4})
        shatter:Play()
        Debris:AddItem(ice, 0.3)
    end)
end

instruction: Write a first-person viewmodel weapon sway and walk bob system in Luau driven by springs and mouse delta.
output:
local UserInputService = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local Spring = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Spring)

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local swaySpring = Spring.new(Vector3.zero, 8, 0.6)   -- x = yaw, y = pitch, z = roll
local bobSpring = Spring.new(Vector3.zero, 10, 0.8)
local OFFSET = CFrame.new(0.6, -0.5, -1.2)

local function bindViewmodel(viewmodel)
    RunService:BindToRenderStep('Viewmodel', Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function(dt)
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not root then return end

        -- mouse delta only reports while the mouse is locked (first person)
        local delta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
        swaySpring:Impulse(Vector3.new(-delta.X, -delta.Y, -delta.X) * 0.02)
        swaySpring.Target = Vector3.zero
        local sway = swaySpring:Update(dt)

        local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
        local moving = math.clamp(speed / 16, 0, 1)
        local t = os.clock()
        bobSpring.Target = Vector3.new(
            math.sin(t * 9) * 0.02 * moving,
            math.abs(math.cos(t * 9)) * 0.02 * moving,
            0
        )
        local bob = bobSpring:Update(dt)

        viewmodel:PivotTo(camera.CFrame * OFFSET * CFrame.new(bob) * CFrame.Angles(sway.Y, sway.X, sway.Z))
    end)
end

return bindViewmodel

instruction: Write a hitbox module in Luau using GetPartBoundsInBox that deduplicates hits per swing, supports debug visualization and is driven by animation markers.
output:
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local Hitbox = {}
Hitbox.__index = Hitbox

function Hitbox.new(character, size, offset, onHit)
    local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
    overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    return setmetatable({
        Debug = false,
        _char = character,
        _size = size,
        _offset = offset,
        _onHit = onHit,
        _overlap = overlap,
        _hit = {},
        _connection = nil,
    }, Hitbox)
end

function Hitbox:Cast()
    local root = self._char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if not root then return end
    local cf = root.CFrame * self._offset
    for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf, self._size, self._overlap) do
        local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
        if model and not self._hit[model] then
            local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                self._hit[model] = true
                self._onHit(model, humanoid, part)
            end
        end
    end
    if self.Debug then
        local box = Instance.new('Part')
        box.Anchored = true
        box.CanCollide = false
        box.CanQuery = false
        box.CanTouch = false
        box.Transparency = 0.7
        box.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
        box.Size = self._size
        box.CFrame = cf
        box.Parent = workspace
        Debris:AddItem(box, 0.1)
    end
end

function Hitbox:Start()   -- call from the 'HitStart' animation marker
    table.clear(self._hit)
    if self._connection then return end
    self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        self:Cast()
    end)
end

function Hitbox:Stop()    -- call from the 'HitEnd' animation marker
    if self._connection then
        self._connection:Disconnect()
        self._connection = nil
    end
end

return Hitbox

instruction: Write an R15 ragdoll module in Luau that swaps Motor6Ds for BallSocketConstraints and can restore the character afterwards.
output:
local function ragdoll(character)
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    if not humanoid then return end

    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
    local root = character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if root then
        root.CanCollide = false
    end

    local created = {}
    local disabledMotors = {}

    for _, motor in character:GetDescendants() do
        if motor:IsA('Motor6D') and motor.Part0 and motor.Part1
            and motor.Name ~= 'Root' and motor.Name ~= 'RootJoint' then
            local a0 = Instance.new('Attachment')
            a0.CFrame = motor.C0
            a0.Parent = motor.Part0

            local a1 = Instance.new('Attachment')
            a1.CFrame = motor.C1
            a1.Parent = motor.Part1

            local socket = Instance.new('BallSocketConstraint')
            socket.Attachment0 = a0
            socket.Attachment1 = a1
            socket.LimitsEnabled = true
            socket.UpperAngle = 60
            socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
            socket.TwistLowerAngle = -40
            socket.TwistUpperAngle = 40
            socket.Parent = motor.Part0

            motor.Enabled = false
            table.insert(created, a0)
            table.insert(created, a1)
            table.insert(created, socket)
            table.insert(disabledMotors, motor)
        end
    end

    local function restore()
        for _, instance in created do
            instance:Destroy()
        end
        for _, motor in disabledMotors do
            motor.Enabled = true
        end
        if root then
            root.CanCollide = true
        end
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end
    return restore
end

return ragdoll
-- Set humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false at spawn if you ragdoll on death.

instruction: Write a knockback function in Luau using modern physics constraints (LinearVelocity) with a velocity decay tween instead of deprecated BodyVelocity.
output:
local TweenService = game:GetService('TweenService')
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')

local function knockback(character, direction, force, duration)
    local root = character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if not root then return end

    local attachment = Instance.new('Attachment')
    attachment.Parent = root

    local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
    local velocity = flat.Unit * force + Vector3.new(0, force * 0.25, 0)

    local linear = Instance.new('LinearVelocity')
    linear.Attachment0 = attachment
    linear.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    linear.MaxForce = math.huge
    linear.VectorVelocity = velocity
    linear.Parent = root

    TweenService:Create(linear, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero,
    }):Play()

    Debris:AddItem(linear, duration + 0.05)
    Debris:AddItem(attachment, duration + 0.05)
end

return knockback

instruction: Implement a client-side melee combo system in Luau with an input buffer, chain window, combo reset timer and server notification per hit.
output:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ContextActionService = game:GetService('ContextActionService')
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')

local AttackRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('AttackRemote')

local COMBO = {
    {Anim = 'rbxassetid://REPLACE_WITH_ATTACK_1_ANIMATION_ID', Duration = 0.45, ChainAt = 0.30},
    {Anim = 'rbxassetid://REPLACE_WITH_ATTACK_2_ANIMATION_ID', Duration = 0.45, ChainAt = 0.30},
    {Anim = 'rbxassetid://REPLACE_WITH_FINISHER_ANIMATION_ID', Duration = 0.80, ChainAt = 0.80},  -- finisher: no chaining
}
local COMBO_RESET = 0.8
local BUFFER_WINDOW = 0.25

local index = 0
local attacking = false
local canChain = false
local bufferedAt = nil
local lastFinished = 0

local cachedAnimator
local trackCache = {}

local function playAnimation(animationId)
    local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
    if not animator or animationId:find('REPLACE_WITH') then return end  -- skip until real ids are set

    if animator ~= cachedAnimator then  -- respawn gives a new Animator
        cachedAnimator = animator
        table.clear(trackCache)
    end

    local track = trackCache[animationId]
    if not track then
        local animation = Instance.new('Animation')
        animation.AnimationId = animationId
        track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
        trackCache[animationId] = track
    end
    track:Play()
end

local performAttack

performAttack = function()
    if os.clock() - lastFinished > COMBO_RESET then
        index = 0
    end
    index = index % #COMBO + 1
    local step = COMBO[index]
    local myIndex = index
    local startTime = os.clock()
    attacking = true
    canChain = false

    AttackRemote:FireServer(myIndex)
    playAnimation(step.Anim)

    task.delay(step.ChainAt, function()
        if index ~= myIndex then return end
        canChain = true
        if bufferedAt and os.clock() - bufferedAt <= BUFFER_WINDOW then
            bufferedAt = nil
            performAttack()
        end
    end)

    task.delay(step.Duration, function()
        if index == myIndex then
            attacking = false
            canChain = false
            lastFinished = os.clock()
        end
    end)
end

local function onAttackInput(_, state)
    if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
    if not attacking or canChain then
        performAttack()
    else
        bufferedAt = os.clock()  -- remember the click and fire it when the chain window opens
    end
end

ContextActionService:BindAction('Attack', onAttackInput, true, Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2)

instruction: Write a server-side block and parry system in Luau with a timing window for perfect parries, facing check, damage reduction and stamina drain.
output:
local PARRY_WINDOW = 0.2
local BLOCK_REDUCTION = 0.7
local BLOCK_ANGLE = 100  -- degrees in front of the defender that can be blocked
local BLOCK_STAMINA_COST = 0.5  -- stamina per point of damage

local Blocking = {}

function Blocking.Start(character)
    character:SetAttribute('BlockStart', workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end

function Blocking.Stop(character)
    character:SetAttribute('BlockStart', nil)
end

local function isFacing(defenderRoot, attackerPosition)
    local toAttacker = attackerPosition - defenderRoot.Position
    toAttacker = Vector3.new(toAttacker.X, 0, toAttacker.Z)
    if toAttacker.Magnitude < 0.01 then return true end
    local look = defenderRoot.CFrame.LookVector
    local angle = math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(look:Dot(toAttacker.Unit), -1, 1)))
    return angle <= BLOCK_ANGLE / 2
end

-- Returns finalDamage, outcome ('Hit' | 'Blocked' | 'Parried' | 'GuardBroken')
function Blocking.Resolve(defender, attackerRoot, damage)
    local blockStart = defender:GetAttribute('BlockStart')
    local root = defender:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if not blockStart or not root or not isFacing(root, attackerRoot.Position) then
        return damage, 'Hit'
    end

    local heldFor = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - blockStart
    if heldFor <= PARRY_WINDOW then
        return 0, 'Parried'  -- caller should stagger the attacker
    end

    local stamina = defender:GetAttribute('Stamina') or 0
    local cost = damage * BLOCK_STAMINA_COST
    if stamina < cost then
        defender:SetAttribute('Stamina', 0)
        defender:SetAttribute('BlockStart', nil)
        return damage, 'GuardBroken'
    end
    defender:SetAttribute('Stamina', stamina - cost)
    return damage * (1 - BLOCK_REDUCTION), 'Blocked'
end

return Blocking

instruction: Create a dodge roll with invincibility frames in Luau: client roll movement via LinearVelocity, server-validated i-frame window and a damage gate.
output:
-- SERVER ---------------------------------------------------------------
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local DodgeRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('DodgeRemote')

local IFRAME_DURATION = 0.35
local COOLDOWN = 1.0
local lastDodge = {}

DodgeRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    if os.clock() - (lastDodge[player] or 0) < COOLDOWN then return end
    lastDodge[player] = os.clock()

    character:SetAttribute('Invulnerable', true)
    task.delay(IFRAME_DURATION, function()
        if character.Parent then
            character:SetAttribute('Invulnerable', nil)
        end
    end)
end)

-- All damage must pass through this gate
local function applyDamage(humanoid, amount)
    local character = humanoid.Parent
    if character and character:GetAttribute('Invulnerable') then
        return false
    end
    humanoid:TakeDamage(amount)
    return true
end

-- CLIENT ---------------------------------------------------------------
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local TweenService = game:GetService('TweenService')
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')

local function dodgeRoll(direction)
    local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    if not root then return end

    local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then
        flat = root.CFrame.LookVector
    end
    flat = flat.Unit

    DodgeRemote:FireServer()

    local attachment = Instance.new('Attachment')
    attachment.Parent = root
    local linear = Instance.new('LinearVelocity')
    linear.Attachment0 = attachment
    linear.MaxForce = math.huge
    linear.VectorVelocity = flat * 45
    linear.Parent = root

    TweenService:Create(linear, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero}):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(linear, 0.4)
    Debris:AddItem(attachment, 0.4)
end

instruction: Implement a poise and stagger system in Luau where damage drains poise, poise regenerates after a delay, and breaking poise staggers the target.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local Poise = {}
local entities = {}  -- [humanoid] = {poise, max, lastHit, regenDelay, regenRate, staggered}

function Poise.Register(humanoid, maxPoise, regenDelay, regenRate)
    entities[humanoid] = {
        poise = maxPoise,
        max = maxPoise,
        lastHit = 0,
        regenDelay = regenDelay or 3,
        regenRate = regenRate or 15,
        staggered = false,
    }
    humanoid.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent then
            entities[humanoid] = nil
        end
    end)
end

-- poiseDamage: separate from health damage so heavy weapons can break guard faster
function Poise.Damage(humanoid, poiseDamage, onStagger)
    local data = entities[humanoid]
    if not data or data.staggered then return end
    data.lastHit = os.clock()
    data.poise -= poiseDamage
    if data.poise <= 0 then
        data.staggered = true
        data.poise = data.max  -- reset on break
        local previousSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
        humanoid.Parent:SetAttribute('Staggered', true)
        if onStagger then onStagger() end
        task.delay(1.0, function()
            data.staggered = false
            if humanoid.Parent then
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = previousSpeed
                humanoid.Parent:SetAttribute('Staggered', nil)
            end
        end)
    end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    local now = os.clock()
    for _, data in entities do
        if not data.staggered and data.poise < data.max and now - data.lastHit > data.regenDelay then
            data.poise = math.min(data.max, data.poise + data.regenRate * dt)
        end
    end
end)

return Poise

instruction: Write the server-side Luau ability module for 'Meteor Strike', a area-of-effect fire ability, with validation, cooldown, server-side hit detection and VFX replication.
output:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local VFXRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('VFXRemote')

local Ability = {
    Name = 'Meteor Strike',
    Cooldown = 4,
    Damage = 15,
    Range = 40,
}

local lastCast = {}

local function getCaster(player)
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
        return character, root, humanoid
    end
end

local function flatDirection(direction)
    if typeof(direction) ~= 'Vector3' or direction ~= direction then return nil end
    local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then return nil end
    return flat.Unit
end

local function ready(player)
    return os.clock() - (lastCast[player] or 0) >= Ability.Cooldown
end

local RADIUS = 12

function Ability.Cast(player, direction)
    local character, root = getCaster(player)
    local flat = character and flatDirection(direction)
    if not flat or not ready(player) then return false end
    lastCast[player] = os.clock()

    local center = root.Position + flat * (Ability.Range * 0.6)  -- ground target in front of the caster
    local params = OverlapParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}

    local hit = {}
    for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(center, RADIUS, params) do
        local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
        local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not hit[model] then
            hit[model] = true
            humanoid:TakeDamage(Ability.Damage)
        end
    end

    VFXRemote:FireAllClients(Ability.Name, center, flat, character, RADIUS)
    return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    lastCast[player] = nil
end)

return Ability

local VFXRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('VFXRemote')

local Ability = {
    Name = 'Holy Judgement',
    Cooldown = 12,
    Damage = 47,
    Range = 45,
}

local lastCast = {}

local function getCaster(player)
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
    if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
        return character, root, humanoid
    end
end

local function flatDirection(direction)
    if typeof(direction) ~= 'Vector3' or direction ~= direction then return nil end
    local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
    if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then return nil end
    return flat.Unit
end

local function ready(player)
    return os.clock() - (lastCast[player] or 0) >= Ability.Cooldown
end

local RADIUS = 12

function Ability.Cast(player, direction)
    local character, root = getCaster(player)
    local flat = character and flatDirection(direction)
    if not flat or not ready(player) then return false end
    lastCast[player] = os.clock()

    local center = root.Position + flat * (Ability.Range * 0.6)  -- ground target in front of the caster
    local params = OverlapParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}

    local hit = {}
    for _, part in workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(center, RADIUS, params) do
        local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model')
        local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not hit[model] then
            hit[model] = true
            humanoid:TakeDamage(Ability.Damage)
        end
    end

    VFXRemote:FireAllClients(Ability.Name, center, flat, character, RADIUS)
    return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    lastCast[player] = nil
end)

return Ability
